items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Every S2 acceptance item (per-loader 1a table cells, D8/D9, S1 hand-offs, docs edit) has a pinned test; verified again by the Stage-1 reviewer.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown/invalid/too-new profiles raise ProfileNotFound/Invalid/SchemaDrift, surfaced as JSON error + exit 2/3 in every loader; no silent fallback remains.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Profile names validated by the resolver (no path traversal), commands only run after a user-invoked phase, shadow warnings on stderr (D8), tamper-evident isolation probe.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Seven new test files, non-vacuous assertions on exit code, source, error text; plugin-cache layout and sys.path-hygiene subprocess probes included.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One resolve per invocation; no extra I/O loops; dev_server stays free of import-time pathlib arithmetic.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Shared glue in profile_consumer.py; touched files net-zero or smaller against bloat caps (test_runner 324, validate_env 589, performance_check 792).

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer of profile JSON and loader result JSON probed round-trip with real files in nine boundary probes across all roots; profile_source added additively.
